```{r}
source("_setup.R")
log <- read_fig_csv("cleaning_log.csv")
```

## Data flow

1. The receiver records every pulse it hears into hourly files and uploads them to motus.org.
2. Motus matches bursts to registered tags and produces hits and runs.
3. The `motus` R package downloads them into a local database.
4. This project's pipeline cleans the detections and writes a small set of handoff tables.
5. Every figure on this site reads only those tables.

Stages 1–3 are the existing Motus system. Stages 4–5 are this project.

## Cleaning

Every rule flags rows rather than deleting them, so this table says exactly how many
detections each decision removed. Ambiguous detections, where a burst matched more than
one registered tag, are set aside for review rather than discarded.

```{r}
log %>% transmute(Rule = rule, Removed = ifelse(is.na(removed), "", format(removed, big.mark = ",")),
                  Remaining = format(remaining, big.mark = ",")) %>% kable(align = "lrr")
```

Thresholds are documented decisions: a run of 3 hits or fewer is treated as noise, and a
gap of more than 2 hours splits a visit. Antenna health uses 6 hours for a flat line and
3 hours for a noise burst.

## Known limitations

- Two stations within range of each other can both hear the same bird, which splits one
  stopover into many short visits and produces implausible "legs" between them. In the
  sample data this affects 64 of 115 legs. A fix is pending a decision on how to merge
  overlapping stations.
- Antenna bearings are missing for 63% of sample detections because they were never
  entered on motus.org. The farm's deployment record will carry them.
- The static maps have no basemap. The interactive versions do.

## Code and documents

The pipeline, the view scripts, the interface control document and the tests are in the
project repository. The interface document fixes units, time zones, file formats and
the port-to-antenna map for the hardware team.

This is coursework. Generative AI tools were used in writing the code, under the
course's disclosure policy; every line was reviewed by the author.
